name: extract_historical_options
description: Extract and format relevant historical options from user's chat history for a specific entity type

display_text.description: User-friendly display text for this option

data.description: Structured data for this option (location details, division name, product specs, etc.)

frequency.description: How often this was used (e.g., 'used 3 times', 'most recent')

context.description: Brief context about when/why this was used

confidence.description: Confidence that this option is relevant to current request

options.description: List of relevant historical options, sorted by relevance and recency

summary.description: Brief summary of the analysis and what options were found

most_likely.description: Which option is most likely what the user wants
